title_fil: Iwasan ang tabako, alak at droga
title_en: Priority area 4: Avoid tobacco, alcohol, and drugs
objectives_fil: Humingi ng pahintulot sa usapan, magbahagi ng nasuring mensahe tungkol sa usok, at mag-alok ng konkretong suporta.
Makinig nang pribado, ilarawan ang naobserbahang concern nang walang label, at iugnay sa kwalipikadong serbisyo.
Magtanong nang walang paghuhusga, tukuyin ang agarang panganib, at iugnay sa angkop na suporta.
objectives_en: Given a smoker's concern or community exposure, give a reviewed prevention/cessation message and support route.
Given a disclosure or family concern, respond without diagnosis or shame and connect to qualified help.
Given an alcohol-related concern, identify risk, a safe conversation, and referral boundary.
summary_fil: Iwasan ang tabako, alak at droga: 3 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 4: Avoid tobacco, alcohol, and drugs: 3 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
